title: Reading Drill — Testing routes in a covered market — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing routes in a covered market — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Hillswick began with reports of visitors walking past stalls that are hard to see. The market manager had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using observation sheets and chose stops per stall as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was an alternate entrance layout. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted eight weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded changes in stall opening times as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
